name: Price Information 2
definition: Amount of money for which goods or services are offered, sold, or bought.

Value.name: Value
Value.definition: Value of the price, eg, as a currency and value.

ValueType.name: Value Type
ValueType.definition: Type of value in which the price is expressed.

Type.name: Type
Type.definition: Type and information about a price.

ExtendedType.name: Extended Type
ExtendedType.definition: Type and information about a price.

SourceOfPrice.name: Source Of Price
SourceOfPrice.definition: Place from which the price was obtained.

QuotationDate.name: Quotation Date
QuotationDate.definition: Date on which the price is obtained. With an investment fund, this is as stated in the prospectus.

Yielded.name: Yielded
Yielded.definition: Indicates whether the price is expressed as a yield. The absence of Yielded means it is not applicable.

ValueRule.definition: If Type is not MRKT, then Value may not be expressed with UnknownIndicator.

TypeOrExtendedTypeRule.definition: Either Type or ExtendedType must be present, but not both.

TypeOrExtendedTypeRuleNotBoth.definition: Either Type or ExtendedType must be present, but not both.
